What merchants think

This is generated by Shopify Magic. It's shown when an app has 100+ reviews and at least a 4.0 overall rating.

Feedback submitted

Merchants say this app is highly effective for COD-heavy stores, reducing fake orders and RTO losses with OTP verification, COD confirmation, RTO intelligence, and PPCOD checkout. They report smoother, higher-converting 1‑click checkout and appreciate customizable COD rules, fees, pincodes, and partial payments. Many call it a gamechanger that integrates smoothly, with onboarding made easy by prompt, patient support via calls, WhatsApp, and Google Meet.
